second-law-isolated-system-f66f6291.title: Second Law of Thermodynamics
second-law-isolated-system-f66f6291.interpretation: Asserts that the total entropy of an isolated system (or the universe as a whole) can never decrease over time, establishing the fundamental directionality of physical processes.
second-law-isolated-system-f66f6291.symmetry_origin: The probabilistic tendency of macroscopic systems to evolve toward macrostates with the overwhelmingly largest volume in phase space.
second-law-isolated-system-f66f6291.limits_and_boundary: In the limit of a perfectly reversible process, the entropy change is exactly zero. For all real, spontaneous processes, the change is strictly positive.
